purpose: Prevent post-race result visibility from contaminating prospective market snapshot evidence when collection occurs late or after race completion.
core_rule: A market observation is admissible only from a source artifact whose own provenance establishes that the quoted prices existed at or before the race decision cutoff. Retrieval time may be later; price timestamp may not be.
admissible_market_evidence: immutable or archived snapshot with source timestamp <= decision cutoff
previously captured bytes with capture timestamp <= decision cutoff and hash/provenance
provider history endpoint that explicitly identifies the historical quote timestamp <= decision cutoff without requiring result-derived reconstruction
inadmissible_market_evidence: current page after race when the page does not prove the displayed odds are the pre-race snapshot
final odds reconstructed from result or payout pages
screenshots or pages where result and price provenance cannot be separated
any price inferred using payout, finish order, or post-race information

late_retrieval_rule.if_valid_historical_snapshot_exists: MARKET_PRICE_MAY_BE_ADMITTED_WITH_ORIGINAL_PRE_CUTOFF_TIMESTAMP; any visible result must be quarantined from feature/model work until the outcome-label stage

outcome_firewall.before_market_lock: Do not intentionally open result, payout, finish-order, replay-result overlay, or result-bearing market page.
outcome_firewall.accidental_result_exposure: Record contamination incident. Do not use the exposed outcome to alter membership, PRE features, market snapshot choice, model parameters, thresholds, or exclusions.
outcome_firewall.outcome_label_stage: Outcome may be joined only after PRE and market evidence for the race are locked or explicitly marked missing.

market_snapshot_target.primary: latest source-verifiable snapshot at or before T-3 minutes

membership_rule: A missing market snapshot does not authorize replacing the prespecified race with another race.
